query: Single-phase fcc FeCoNi has high saturation magnetization but a low coercive field, and reported single-phase fcc high-entropy alloys derived from it have coercive fields no greater than 100 Oe in the reported magnetic measurements. What single intervention could overcome this coercivity limitation? Formulate one hypothesis specifying the intervention, its mechanism, the predicted change relative to single-phase fcc FeCoNi or a matched derivative, the relevant compositional, structural, and measurement boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a controlled experiment with an explicit falsification criterion.

generation.hypothesis: Adding a small percentage of a magnetic element such as Co or Ni to single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloys will increase the coercive field beyond 100 Oe.
generation.material_initial_state: single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloys with high saturation magnetization and low coercive field (no greater than 100 Oe)
generation.intervention: Addition of a magnetic element (e.g., Co or Ni)
generation.conditions: Controlled magnetic measurements at room temperature
generation.structural_mediator: Increased magnetic anisotropy due to the addition of the magnetic element
generation.mechanism: The addition of Co or Ni enhances magnetic interactions and stabilizes the magnetic phase, leading to increased coercivity.
generation.predicted_outcome: The coercive field will exceed 100 Oe, indicating improved magnetic stability and performance.
generation.baseline: Single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloys with coercive fields no greater than 100 Oe.
generation.boundary: Compositional boundaries include the percentage of Co or Ni added; structural boundaries include maintaining the fcc phase.
generation.uncertainty: The exact percentage of Co or Ni required to achieve the desired increase in coercivity is uncertain and may vary.

falsification_experiment.design: Synthesize a series of single-phase fcc FeCoNi high-entropy alloys with varying percentages of Co or Ni and measure their coercive fields.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If all synthesized alloys with added Co or Ni still exhibit coercive fields no greater than 100 Oe, the hypothesis is falsified.
